name: teamwork-skill
description: AI-native collaboration skills for direct work, discussion, deep research, debugging, planning, review, setup, updates, and persistent goals in Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Focused collaboration methods that keep clear work direct.
interface.longDescription: Teamwork keeps clear Codex work native and adds focused methods for discussion, deep research, unknown-cause debugging, executable planning, review, project setup, Codex refresh, and persistent goals. An optional low-cost Writer can preserve owner-confirmed results in plain Markdown without becoming a workflow gate. Codex remains in control of tools and permissions.
defaultPrompt: Use $teamwork-update to inspect or refresh this Codex Teamwork installation.
Use $teamwork-collaborate to explore this decision with me and recommend a direction.
Use $teamwork-research to investigate this external question across primary sources.
